tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
df = u.merge(c, on='instance_type', suffixes=('_cur',''))
df['req_vcpu'] = df.vcpu * df.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
df['req_mem'] = df.memory_gib * df.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8
total = 0.0
for _, row in df.iterrows():
    fam = c[c.family == row.family]
    cand = fam[(fam.vcpu >= row.req_vcpu) & (fam.memory_gib >= row.req_mem)]
    if len(cand):
        rec = cand.loc[cand.hourly_usd.idxmin()]
        new_type, new_cost = rec.instance_type, rec.hourly_usd*730
    else:
        new_type, new_cost = row.instance_type, row.hourly_usd*730
    total += (row.hourly_usd - new_cost/730) * 730
    print(row.instance_id, row.instance_type, '->', new_type, round((row.hourly_usd - new_cost/730)*730,2))
print('TOTAL', round(total,2))

for _, row in df.iterrows():
